chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Mu'awiya ibn Wahb said:
I asked, 'What is the minimum distance at which the traveler shortens the prayer?' He said, 'One Bair (approx. 40km) going and one Bair returning.'
ai.seo_question: What is the minimum distance for shortening prayer in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the minimum distance (adna) for shortening prayers (qasr) as two Bair (approximately 80 kilometers) for a round trip, a standard measure in Shia jurisprudence. It highlights the practical application of the traveler's concession, ensuring that the ruling applies only when the journey exceeds this threshold, thereby balancing ease with religious obligation.
